tasks.artifact_paths_note: The new driver smth001_driver.py and implementation.md are declared HERE AND NOW rather than by later amendment, because tools/research_dispatch.py derives TASK-20260801-015's expected commit scope as the union of that archive task's artifact_paths with this task's. Build the two toy curve instances at bits 16 and 20 from master seed 2201; build the frozen 512-element deterministic factor base at each; compute the frozen intermediate map INT-1 EXHAUSTIVELY over all C(513,2) = 131328 unordered half-tuples under the primary encoding ENC-B and the power-certificate encoding ENC-A; draw the matched null OBJ-NULL-UNIF uniformly on [1, p**2] and the apparatus-identity control OBJ-NULL-SYNTH at the same count; factor every sample, record its largest prime factor and its Bsm-smoothness indicator at every rung of the frozen Bsm ladder; compute the KS, rate-band, tail, two-sample KS and decay statistics; and re-verify every factorization through an independent verifier path. Observe and record only. Interpret nothing and classify nothing against the reading rule.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the integer invariants of the half-arity Semaev partial map obey the Dickman smoothness law at toy scale - the question HEUR-DS-1 asserts an answer to and which has never been measured on the correct object.
constraints: run_authorized ONLY if TASK-20260801-013 records APPROVAL_DETERMINATION APPROVED; otherwise cancel with no run and say so.
DO NOT READ-MODIFY, IMPORT, EDIT OR STAGE ANY FILE UNDER experiments/EXP-DS-001/. The driver is new and standalone.

FORBIDDEN ANTI-PATTERN AP-1: do NOT set smoothness_abort = true on any EXP-DS-001 arm and do not represent any such run as exercising this mechanism. That calls is_B_smooth on an identity-encoded x-coordinate below 2**20 - a stand-in, not the Semaev intermediate - and produces a false ledger tick while testing nothing.

NO SEARCH ARMS, NO TIMING DECISION VARIABLE, NO COST IDENTITY, NO R, no naive arm, no split arm, no claw table, no relation harvest. wall_seconds_total is recorded for budget accounting only and is never a decision variable.

The run manifest is manifest.yaml, NOT manifest.json, and the companion artifacts are command.txt, environment.json, stdout.log, stderr.log and raw-result.json - the exact filenames tools/validate_ledger.py check_run requires beside an indexed manifest.

The manifest must carry id, experiment_id, status, code with commit and command, environment, inputs with parameters, timing and result; result.certificate.kind must be the literal string none, because no discrete logarithm and no decomposition is claimed.
n = 131328 per sample set, exhaustive over half-tuples for the real sets. Report any short set as short; never pad, impute or extrapolate a sample.
